plans.idea: Classic leaderboard: one wide text column carrying brand, headline and the three steps reads left to right into a right-hand action column where the CTA sits at optical centre with the legal set small beneath it.

Two-tier banner: the copy gets the full canvas width across the top so the headline and steps can run long and large, with a footer rail pairing the fine print on the left and the CTA anchored bottom-right as the end of the reading path.

Content block with a CTA sidecar and a full-width legal baseline: text fills the upper-left field, the CTA floats mid-height on the right aligned to the text block, and the disclaimer runs as a single quiet line along the bottom edge.
